requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-based productivity features including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan to enhance workflow and manageability for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: AI solutions are key differentiators and address SMB needs for efficiency and ease of management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features (Perfect Print, Perfect Scan) are functional and demonstrably improve workflow efficiency in lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for small office device management, targeting unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs, enabling easy monitoring and control of printers.
requirements.Rationale: SMB customers lack dedicated IT; a portal simplifies management and aligns with customer pain points.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible, supports device management for SMBs, and passes usability testing with target customer profiles.

requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Technology
requirements.Description: Implement HP’s first business-focused ink tank solution with lowest business TCO, targeting SMB segment.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive gap in CISS PLE Hi segment; supports strategic intent to retain SMB market share.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink tank solution delivers lowest TCO compared to competitors in independent testing.
requirements.citation: Magellan MRD, Page 4, Page 6, Page 11, Page 12

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refill
requirements.Description: Design and implement keyed bottles for ink refilling to ensure compatibility and minimize errors.
requirements.Rationale: Keyed bottles are listed as a dependency for serviceability and quality assurance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are tested for error-proof compatibility and accepted by service teams.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Develop a replaceable maintenance box for ease of servicing, with customer-replaceable option prioritized.
requirements.Rationale: New feature for Magellan, reduces service intervention and aligns with SMB needs for minimal maintenance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is customer-replaceable in >80% of cases, verified in service trials.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Offer warranty of 80k pages or 2 years (whichever is first) with customer-replaceable PHA and MINK at service center.
requirements.Rationale: Warranty and serviceability are key dependencies for market acceptance and reduced cost of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published; serviceability meets threshold for customer-replaceable parts as defined by service center feedback.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Speed Improvement
requirements.Description: Improve PDL SKU speed to 25/20 ppm (from current 25/19), with support for PDL/PS and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Speed improvement and certification are competitive differentiators for PDL SKUs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm in benchmark tests and passes Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Sustainability - Recycled Content Percentage (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure printer is manufactured with at least 60% recycled content (RCP), surpassing competitors (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and customer priority for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent audit confirms 60% RCP in final product.

requirements.Title: Minimal Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design printer for minimal maintenance, with fewer parts to replace over product lifetime.
requirements.Rationale: Maintenance free or less maintenance is a top feature requested by SMBs; reduces intervention and cost.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer requires fewer maintenance interventions compared to competitors, as measured in field trials.

requirements.Title: PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Support Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) business model, including integration with SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: PaaS is a strategic goal and dependency for Magellan’s business model.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer and portal integrate seamlessly with PaaS platform; passes pilot deployment with SMB customers.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement robust telemetry features for device monitoring, usage analytics, and proactive support.
requirements.Rationale: Telemetry is required for manageability and support in SMB environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is accessible, accurate, and meets privacy/security standards in pilot tests.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing through the HP App, supporting SMB workflows.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a key customer priority and enhances usability for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is functional and passes usability tests with SMB users.

requirements.Title: Advanced Solutions Monetization
requirements.Description: Develop features and business models to monetize advanced AI and device management solutions for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Solutions monetization is a top priority for the next 3-5 years.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Revenue is generated from advanced solutions in pilot programs.
